subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support temporary channel-level active-agent switching, and if so should it be a generic policy-gated routing/session binding contract rather than a command shim over existing session tools?
rationale: The request changes channel command semantics, session routing, agent memory isolation, and cross-agent security policy; source inspection does not show an existing supported contract to extend mechanically.

options.title: Add policy-gated active-agent routing
options.body: Introduce a generic conversation/session route override with explicit authorization, persistence, cleanup, tests, and docs before wiring channel commands to it.

options.title: Keep static bindings plus thread focus
options.body: Decline dynamic configured-agent switching and document static bindings, TUI/Control UI selection, and thread-bound /focus as the supported model.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Keep this issue open as an API/design discussion until a plugin or channel owner proves the missing generic seam.

recommendation.title: Add policy-gated active-agent routing
recommendation.body: Introduce a generic conversation/session route override with explicit authorization, persistence, cleanup, tests, and docs before wiring channel commands to it.

likelyOwner.reason: The core decision centers on route resolution and Gateway/channel session routing, where vincentkoc has the strongest recent history signal.
